'''Imperial City University''' was an educational institution located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was the site of an incident in which a group of [[Vesarian]] students were killed by a unit of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Imperial Sector Police]]. In the wake of the altercation, the unit's [[Centurion (Coruscant police)|centurion]] was arrested and faced trial. However, the incident cast the Sector Police's reputation as a non-political institution into doubt.<ref name="Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows">[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]</ref>
